_comment: Check 6 runs these against the UNZIPPED CANDIDATE ({dist}). Selection rule: deterministic, no network except the capped Mapbox side channel, and together under about 25 minutes, so eight consecutive passes stay practical. The full suite (tools/t0/run_suites.mjs, about 2.5 hours, 75 suites) is available with --full. Durations are from release/test-summary.json (R1c rows) unless marked.

node.why: the release mechanism of the candidate: one Document on first visit, service worker controls without navigation, one Mapbox sku, the upgrade drill (old worker + old bundle)

the data and clock accuracy journeys J1-J8: play 30 ticks, pan/wheel/pinch, select, search, Help, day 2/3 jump (dates read July 1-3 1863, never July 4-9), ?ancestor= deep link; group B clock and data tests
single URL-state reader (tick, day, unit, z, ll, ancestor, vignette), moments.json and Turning Points anchors
keyboard focus after click/drag, Tab to the map and Esc, unit canvas follows the map, attribution, NPS tour
owner constraint: the Virtual Walkthrough (16 stops, 512 monuments, Monuments tab, Back without leaks) must never break
the truthful-copy rows are in the bundle and Help

accuracy of the order of battle: no record has more casualties than men unless flagged, the 107th Pennsylvania and 6th US Cavalry records, /regiment and /report never print a rate above 100 percent (R1d printed 135.2 and 107.1)
generated _headers/_redirects/netlify.toml rules: one rule per header name per URL, both URL spellings, Permissions-Policy, CSP (browser part is covered by check 2)
the eight map sub-pages load Mapbox without blocking, og card, manifest
non-blocking stylesheets, inlined first-paint rules, no layout shift, Mapbox shader precompile
the page defect pack PGC-01..27 (duplicate ids under data delay, dashboard, report, regiment, historian, living ledger ...)

npm.why: npm run data:check without npm: data manifest, validator suite, unit registry, facts, rights audit (pure Node)
npm run time:check: clock oracle anchors, golden values, playback, solar checks
historian intent rules, text handling, sources register

notInSubset.why: about 8 minutes; axe on every page and the app is repeated by check 7 (six widths) and check 4 (keyboard, preferences)
about 10 minutes; axe/overflow/target-size on 25 pages at 1440/375/320 is repeated by check 7 at six widths
about 4-6 minutes each with four parallel Chrome processes; the phone shell is exercised by checks 4, 5 and 7 (touch, 390x844); use --full for the viewport matrix
they prove the TESTS discriminate against legacy/control trees, not that the candidate is right
